output_list.criticism: The transfer function does not check if the sender has sufficient balance before transferring tokens. This could allow a user to transfer more tokens than they have, potentially leading to a loss of funds.

The transferFrom function does not check if the sender has sufficient balance before transferring tokens. This could allow a user to transfer more tokens than they have, potentially leading to a loss of funds.
The buy function allows users to buy tokens at a rate lower than the actual buy rate. This could allow users to buy more tokens than they should be able to, potentially leading to a loss of funds.
The withdrawToOwner function allows users to withdraw more tokens than they have. This could allow users to withdraw more tokens than they should be able to, potentially leading to a loss of funds.
